primary_family: 24 paired AP degradation differences across six tasks and four conditions
secondary_family: 24 paired perturbed AP differences across six tasks and four conditions
confidence_scope: patient sampling conditional on saved fits, cohort and fixed perturbation; five-seed SD reported separately

run_protocol.primary: difference of AP changes: (duration perturbed-clean) minus (window perturbed-clean)
run_protocol.seed_aggregation: per-seed AP/paired contrast, then average; no prediction pooling
run_protocol.p_values: null-centered paired bootstrap; Holm separately in each full 24-contrast family
run_protocol.fixed_deletion: reuse archived deterministic hash; nested 25/50 percent masks shared across views and models
run_protocol.normalization: reuse each model original training-fitted transforms; never refit
run_protocol.time_rules: original laboratory availability, 24h cutoff; unchanged specimen times and original MIMIC-III proxy
run_protocol.execution: CPU FP32, four threads per batch, batch 256, four independent batches in parallel; exact serial/parallel replay
